title: finding(.claude/agents): os-dev.md:279 tells every dev to copy a `Clause-②:` line into the PR body for a reader objectui does not have — and an objectui claim has no such line to copy
body:
`.claude/agents/os-dev.md:279` tells every dispatched dev, unconditionally:

> 正文行首照抄认领的 `Clause-②:` 行:`Check Changeset` 读正文不读卡,开 PR 那一笔就带上。

⚠️ Both halves of that line are **repo-conditional**, and the file says so nowhere. Measured this act by a dev working an **objectui** card (objectui#9874) and re-taken at source by the seat:

1. **There may be nothing to copy.** The claim comment on an objectui card carries no `Clause-②:` line — the line is produced by the clause-② flow, which is a `domain:spec` / `domain:skills` mechanism. The dev followed the instruction, found no source line, and reported it rather than inventing one.
2. **The reader the rationale names does not exist in that repo.** objectui has **no** `check-clause2-carriers.mjs`, and its own gate says so verbatim — `objectui:scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs:1959`, read on `origin/main` `00c4df509`:

   > ⚠️ objectui has no `check-clause2-carriers.mjs` to defer the verdict question

   Control from the same command: `changeset` occurs in five objectui workflow files (`changelog.yml` 4, `changeset-guard.yml` 31, `changeset-presence.yml` 37, `changeset-release.yml` 119, `ci.yml` 10) ⇒ the instrument reads that corpus; the absence is a reading, ⛔ not a failed search.

⇒ ⭐ in objectstack the line is right: `scripts/pm/check-clause2-carriers.mjs` exists and its own header describes a **dual carrier**, selecting 「the claim comment SELECTED as the carrier」 with the PR body as the second limb. ⛔ In objectui the same sentence instructs a dev to satisfy a reader that is not there.

## What this card does ⛔ NOT claim

- ⛔ **Not** that the dev was blocked: nothing was copied because there was nothing to copy, the PR opened normally, and no gate complained. The cost is a dev spending a step on a non-existent obligation and a seat spending a reading to confirm it — ⛔ not a broken landing.
- ⛔ **Not** a proposal to delete the line. The right shape (make it conditional on the repo, or on the claim actually carrying the line, or name the dual carrier's owning lane) is the skills seat's call, ⛔ not this seat's.

## Dedupe words

`os-dev Clause-② PR body` · `check-clause2-carriers absent objectui` · `dispatch instruction repo-conditional` · `dual carrier claim comment` · `Check Changeset reads body`
